content: The grid search was repeated independently for every variant that we tested. Furthermore, the standard recommendations for fine-tuning Bert were used: Adam with ${\beta }_1=0.9$ and ${\beta }_2=0.999$; an L2 weight decay of $0.01$; a learning rate warmup over the first 10% of the steps; and a linear decay of the learning rate. A dropout probability of 0.1 was set on all layers.
